subject: Matemática e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Interpretar e comparar conjuntos de dados estatísticos por meio de diferentes diagramas e gráficos (histograma, de caixa (box-plot), de ramos e folhas, entre outros), reconhecendo os mais eficientes para sua análise.

components.description_pt: Interpretar dados representados em histogramas, diagramas de caixa e gráficos de ramo-folha
components.description_en: Interpret data represented in histograms, box plots, and stem-and-leaf plots
components.cc_component_description: Represent data with a box plot

components.description_pt: Comparar dois ou mais conjuntos de dados usando diferentes diagramas ou gráficos estatísticos
components.description_en: Compare two or more data sets using different statistical diagrams or graphs
components.cc_component_description: Compare two or more different data sets using the center and spread of each

components.description_pt: Identificar representação gráfica mais eficaz para dada análise estatística
components.description_en: Identify the most effective graphical representation for a given statistical analysis
components.cc_component_description: Select an appropriate tool (e.g., ruler, protractor, spreadsheet, number line) for a given task

components.description_pt: Extrair informações estatísticas como mediana, quartis ou frequência de diagrama dado
components.description_en: Extract statistical information such as median, quartiles, or frequency from a given diagram
components.cc_component_description: Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context by calculating quantitative measures of center (median and/or mean)

cc_matches.description: Represent data with plots on the real number line (dot plots, histograms, and box plots).

*Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context, such as by* giving quantitative measures of center (median and/or mean) and variability (interquartile range and/or mean absolute deviation), as well as describing any overall pattern and any striking deviations from the overall pattern with reference to the context in which the data were gathered.
Use statistics appropriate to the shape of the data distribution to compare center (median, mean) and spread (interquartile range, standard deviation) of two or more different data sets.
